$comment: Manual catalog additions for widgets and properties NOT present in the open-source profoundui-client runtime (e.g. PLS custom widget kits, newer commercial widgets). Loaded and merged on top of properties.json by the validator and the widget-MD generator. Entries should be minimal but accurate — at minimum 'category' and 'appliesTo' so the validator recognizes them. Add more metadata (help, choices, default) as it becomes available.

options.help: Comma- or whitespace-separated list of option values rendered by the widget. Multi-occurrence — additional entries are stored as 'options 2', 'options 3', etc. Format observed in the wild: '2=Update  4=Delete  5=Display' (numeric code = label).
options._extensionSource: Observed in PLS custom widget kit (prof-src/userdata/widget_sets.json) and real RDFs.
